start: Profile tab, member with 27 workouts in the last 3 months

user_sees: Big number like '41,230 kg', 'Last 3 months' with a down arrow
Caption like 'Kg lifted in the last 3 months · 27 workouts'
A line, one point per week; chips 'Duration', 'Kg lifted', 'Reps'
must_not: A week with no workout left out instead of a point on zero

user_sees: Big number and caption for that week
'See these workouts' and the button back to the 3-month total

steps.action: Tap the box over the point
user_sees: With one workout that week: that workout opens; with several: the workout history for exactly that week
must_not: A history list of other dates
Two pages opened by a fast second tap
The sheet staying open after a pick

user_sees: Month points with month names; a gym member sees it free
On the free plan with the chart limit on: the limit pop-up with a way to Plus
must_not: A gym member asked to pay for older charts

start: Profile chart with today's Up next workout; Progress tab 'Today' card

steps.action: Tap the 'Today' line under the chart
Tap the 'Today' card on the Progress tab
user_sees: The Workout tab opens, where Up next starts it
must_not: The workout starting without Up next

start: Profile chart with no workouts, or a failed read

steps.action: Open the Profile as a member with no workouts
user_sees: 'No workouts yet. Your history shows here.'

steps.action: Open it when the history cannot be read
Pick a range with no workouts in it
must_not: 'No workouts yet' for a member who has workouts

start: Profile chart with a picked point

steps.action: Tap the button back to the total
user_sees: The big number is the 3-month total again, no point picked
must_not: The pick staying on the line

user_sees: The pick clears and the total shows
must_not: A pick kept at the same position in new points (another week)

steps.action: Log a workout and come back
user_sees: The chart read again with the new workout
